title: How It Works
subtitle: Follow these simple steps to find and book your perfect property with Nestorria.
ctaBody: Browse our available properties and find your next stay.
s1d: Browse our catalog of available properties. Use filters to narrow down by type, price range, or location.
s2d: Found something you like? Click on any property to see full details including photos, location and reviews.
s3d: Select your check-in and check-out dates. The system will verify availability in real time.
s4d: Follow a simple checklist before confirming your stay.
s5d: Choose the lifestyle that fits you: city, beach or countryside.
s6d: Access your bookings from your profile. View contracts and pay via Stripe, all in one place.
